note: USFS campground with several sites are right on the creek.  --AWH  Primitive '1950s style' camping popular with hunters, on a Shenandoah Mountain drainage in Pendleton County; reached from Bergton, VA on VA 826 (CO Route 31) and FS 526. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms no fee, open year-round, 9 sites, vault toilets and no potable water (written manual). It says nothing on reservations, so the derived first-come booking stays; no site lengths or hookups stated.
flags: Entry has no phone. The Forest Service page gives the North River Ranger District office, 540-432-0187 (Harrisonburg, VA).
